summary: Season 9 introduces 9 new heroes and 4 new exclusive artifacts that completely shift the endgame meta. Folvarst emerges as a game-changing Aura DPS/buffer that outperforms Lincos even at low inspiration levels. Seraphine elevates Ice Blast teams to compete directly with top-tier Dauntless teams in Temporal Vortex IV by providing massive defense, cleansing, and max HP buffs. Lariel replaces Sacredeia in Corrosion teams, boosting Rook's damage to record-breaking levels in AoE content. Meanwhile, Seonios offers unique 1v1 isolation mechanics tailored primarily for PvP.

heroes.name: Folvarst
heroes.verdict: Must-have meta game-changer for Aura teams
heroes.note: Replaces Lincos by buffing allied Aura ultimate damage by 30% and transferring energy, easily outdamaging I5 Lincos teams even at I0.

heroes.name: Seraphine
heroes.note: Provides teamwide 60% DEF boost, debuff cleanse, control immunity, and converts taken damage into permanent max HP and ATK buffs.

heroes.name: Lariel
heroes.note: Replaces Sacredeia in Corrosion comps by applying Tear for 35% DEF reduction and summoning clone hounds that deal true damage based on Corrosion value.

heroes.name: Seonios
heroes.note: Reduces enemy DEF based on mastery and pulls the highest ATK enemy into an isolated 1v1 Corrosion Realm while blocking energy recovery.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Replaced by Folvarst who provides significantly higher team damage output even at lower inspiration ranks.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Replaced by Lariel in top Corrosion lineups, though she also gains a strong new exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Reaches extreme damage numbers when paired with Lariel's Tear defense reduction and Corrosion synergy.

teams.note: New S9 Aura team reaching over 4.6 billion damage on test server, significantly beating previous Lincos setups.
Ice Blast comp utilizing Seraphine for survival and buffs, achieving 30+ billion damage to rival top Dauntless teams.
High-investment Corrosion team dealing over 71.8 billion total damage in AoE boss encounters.

meta_changes: Aura team meta shifts from Lincos to Folvarst, who provides massive passive teamwide damage amplification for Lumina/Aura heroes.
Ice Blast teams reach top-tier Temporal Vortex IV performance thanks to Seraphine's defensive, cleansing, and permanent scaling buffs.
Corrosion teams receive Lariel, who applies stackable Tear DEF reduction and drives Rook's true damage output through the roof.
Four new exclusive artifacts arrive for Sacredeia, Larclys, Monalisse, and Blah Blah.
tips: Prioritize pulling for new exclusive support heroes like Seraphine, as they enable existing DPS cores to survive and compete in high-tier content without requiring multiple I5 heroes.
Consider long-term value when choosing banners in Option Summons II, as new Aura and Corrosion heroes significantly shift element rankings.
For new or F2P players, focus on obtaining core exclusive supports at I0 rather than chasing high inspiration levels on expensive DPS units.
